## What's Changed
* [Backport release-1.37] Apply client-side when force-upgrading Helm charts by @k0s-bot in https://github.com/k0sproject/k0s/pull/8721
* [Backport release-1.37] Bump k3s-io/kine to v0.17.4 by @k0s-bot in https://github.com/k0sproject/k0s/pull/8736
* [Backport release-1.37] Document that Autopilot downloads are unverified without a digest by @k0s-bot in https://github.com/k0sproject/k0s/pull/8733
* [Backport release-1.37] Bump Traefik to v3.7.14-k0s.1 by @k0s-bot in https://github.com/k0sproject/k0s/pull/8728
* [Backport release-1.37]  Use synctest in NLLB patch tests by @k0s-bot in https://github.com/k0sproject/k0s/pull/8719
* [Backport release-1.37] Unify forceUpgrade descriptions in Helm docs by @k0s-bot in https://github.com/k0sproject/k0s/pull/8727


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/k0sproject/k0s/compare/v1.37.2+k0s.0...v1.37.2+k0s.1
